lesson.uz:
Flowgorithm’da Start va End orasiga Output blokini qo‘ying. Matn qo‘shtirnoq ichida yoziladi: "Salom". Son yoki ifoda esa qo‘shtirnoqsiz yoziladi: 12 + 3. New Line yoqilsa, keyingi natija yangi qatordan chiqadi.
File → Save orqali .fprg fayl saqlang. Bu mavzuda Input kerak emas: topshiriqdagi aniq matn yoki hisob natijasini chiqaring. Bo‘sh joylar va qatorlar tartibini tekshiring.
lesson.en:
Place Output between Start and End. Put text in double quotes: "Hello". Write numbers and expressions without quotes: 12 + 3. Enable New Line to move the next output to another line.
Save a .fprg file using File → Save. This topic needs no Input: print the specified text or calculated result. Check spaces and line order.
